concept.reason: Real skeleton and four-view skull sufficient.

classification: Reptilia, Sauropterygia, Placodontia, Henodontidae; not Testudines
scope: Original whole organism with very broad transversely rectangular low armour and flat square-ended mouth.
specimen_basis: Tuebingen complete skeleton official Water Reptiles Hall image; skull GPIT-PV-30003 in Pommery et al2021 Fig1.

scale.basis: Museum catalogue18663 about1m taxon estimate. Skull figure2cm bar; do not equate different specimens.

diagnostic_targets: Carapace wider transversely than fore-aft, broad flat squared oval/rectangle; not high dome or circular modern turtle shell.
Very short neck and broad rectangular head, straight square mouth edge; no tapered pointed turtle beak.
Four short gracile laterally extending limbs with modest paddle/webbed soft tissue inference, not long marine turtle flippers.
Short tapering tail; whole animal continuous and visibly complete.
Subtle polygonal osteoderm pattern across low armour, no bulky ornamental spikes.
uncertainties: Skin colour, webbing and soft tissue thickness inferred; skeleton photograph is flattened fossil not exact living height.
Retains four functional crushing teeth in posterior mouth; closed mouth may hide them. Never describe completely toothless.
Feeding modes debated; no invented exposed baleen or external filter apparatus.
acceptance_checks: Top silhouette broad transverse armour exceeds fore-aft armour length.
Front and top show square broad jaw, not pointed turtle beak.
All four short limbs and short tail visible, no fossil slab or exposed skeleton.
handoff_contract: Same dir prep maker QA; maker fixedhash COMPLETE stops. Root async backup and local-first integration; no maker upload/cleanup.
material_profile: Palette-only opaque PBR, flat normals, no textures; muted olive reconstruction colours are inferred.
origin: Floor footprint center, identity root; lowest foot z=0.001m tolerance.
